records.title: Automatic matching never attaches on a title alone; summaries never admit a title below 0.94
records.body: {"decision": "Owner chose option C on 2026-11-02 (of A current, B long titles only, C never title alone, D sweep rule).", "ingest": "EntryIngest.Evidence blocks an automatic attach without agreeing creator, cover or summary evidence (year alone never admits); applies to match-on-ingest, discovery attaches and reset-hint revalidation.", "import": "CandidateEvidence: a title at the floor needs a summary >= 0.82, a creator >= 0.92 or the backup-source reference; title-only candidates (TitleOnly) take part in the exact-cover check, which then decides with a single match; summary paths below the floor no longer admit (hard rule 2).
